meta.title: Yoyo Travel — Explore More. Collect Memories.
meta.description: Discover provinces and places across Thailand, randomize trips, and keep your personal travel passport.

auth.demoBanner: Demo mode: sign-in is not configured yet. Your travel records are stored in this browser only.
auth.signInToSave: Sign in to save your travel records
auth.loginBody: Use your Google account to save visited provinces and places, your wishlist and trip plans. Your data is private by default.
auth.notConfiguredBody: The site owner has not configured Supabase and Google OAuth yet. You can keep using demo mode; data stays in this browser only.
auth.privacyNote: We only request your name, email and profile picture from Google to show your profile.

home.heroTitle: Explore more. Collect memories in every province.
home.heroSubtitle: Discover all 77 provinces on a real map, randomize trips from real records, and keep your travel passport.
home.mapSubtitle: Tap a province for details. Colours show your travel status.
home.popularTitle: Provinces with the most places in our data
home.popularBasis: Sorted by number of places in our dataset (not visitor statistics)
home.curatedTitle: Places with the most Wikipedia articles
home.curatedBasis: Sorted by how many Wikipedia language editions cover the place (Wikidata sitelinks) — a rough measure of international recognition, not reviews or current popularity
home.foodBasis: Venue data from OpenStreetMap. No verified menus, prices or review scores yet.
home.dataNote: Place coverage is not exhaustive and grows from permitted sources.

explore.title: Explore Thailand
explore.subtitle: 77 provinces across 6 regions
explore.mapError: Could not load map data. Showing the province list instead.

province.empty: No places in this category yet. We do not invent records; more will be added from verifiable sources.
province.seasonNote: General climate guidance for the region, not a weather forecast.
province.distanceFromBkk: About {km} km from Bangkok in a straight line (road distance is longer).
province.costUnknown: No verified transport, accommodation or menu prices for this province yet. Please check with providers directly.
province.visitedPlaces: Visited {visited} of {total} places in our data
province.coverageNote: Only places available in our data sources are shown; coverage is not complete.

place.noDescription: No description from our sources yet.
place.openingHoursOsm: From OpenStreetMap — please re-check before travelling
place.feeFree: Free entry (OpenStreetMap data, not officially confirmed)
place.aiQ1: When is the best time to visit {name} and how long should I spend?
place.aiQ2: What else is worth seeing near {name}?
place.privateNote: This note is private and only visible to you.

random.title: Randomizer
random.subtitle: Random picks from real records that match your filters
random.budgetNote: Budget is estimated from distance to Bangkok only — not real prices.
random.preferWishlist: Prefer provinces on my want-to-visit list
random.noMatch: Nothing matches these filters. Try loosening them.
random.reasonCompanion: {count} places that usually suit {companion} trips (general suggestion)
random.reasonCompanionPlace: This type usually suits {companion} trips (general suggestion)
random.tripWarning: This is an outline from available data, not a booking. Re-check opening hours and details before you travel.
random.warnFew: Few places in our data for this province, so some days are short.
random.warnNoFood: No restaurants in our data near these stops.
random.warnHours: Some places have no opening-hours data.
random.warnStraight: Stops are ordered by straight-line distance, so the order is approximate.
random.pickProvinceFirst: Choose a province, or leave empty to pick one at random

passport.title: My Travel Passport
passport.subtitle: Track the provinces and places you've visited
passport.progressDef: Progress = provinces marked visited ÷ 77 (visiting some places does not count the whole province as visited)
passport.empty: No travel records yet. Pick a province on the map and tap “Visited”.
passport.privacy: Your passport is private and never shared without your permission.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.subtitle: Places you want to visit, grouped by province

trips.title: Trip Planner
trips.subtitle: Create plans, arrange places by day, and track your budget
trips.name: Trip name
trips.namePlaceholder: e.g. Chiang Mai in the cool season
trips.noItems: No places in this trip yet. Add them from a place page or search below.
trips.itemsNoCost: {count, plural, one {# item has} other {# items have}} no cost entered
trips.noBooking: Yoyo Travel does not make bookings. Please book through authorised providers.
trips.duplicate: This place is already in the trip

top.title: Top 10 & picks
top.subtitle: Every ranking states its basis and data source
top.provinces: Top 10 provinces by attractions in our data
top.provincesBasis: Count of attractions (excluding restaurants and stays) in our dataset — reflects data coverage, not visitor numbers
top.attractionsBasis: Number of Wikipedia language editions with an article about the place (Wikidata sitelinks) — a proxy for international recognition, not review scores
top.freeBasis: Places tagged fee=no in OpenStreetMap — please confirm with the venue
top.seasonalBasis: Based on Thailand's general climate patterns (Thai Meteorological Department), not a forecast
top.perProvinceHint: Choose a province to see its 10 places with the most Wikipedia coverage
top.restaurantsNone: No verified ratings or reviews yet, so restaurants, cafes and stays are not ranked.
top.trendingNone: Not enough recent usage data yet, so no “Trending Now” list is shown.
top.timeNote: “This week / this month” filters will be enabled once time-based data exists.
top.familyBasis: Parks, zoos, museums and activities, sorted by Wikipedia coverage
top.couplesBasis: Beaches, islands, viewpoints and mountains, sorted by Wikipedia coverage

seasons.tipCool: Pleasant weather in the north and northeast — great for mountains, viewpoints and national parks.
seasons.tipHot: Seas on both the Gulf and Andaman coasts are mostly calm — good for beaches and islands.
seasons.tipRainy: Waterfalls and forests are lush, but the Andaman coast is rough during the southwest monsoon — check boat notices.
seasons.tipGulfSouth: The lower Gulf coast usually gets heavy rain around Oct–Dec.
seasons.gulf: Lower Gulf coast: generally best Jan–Sep
seasons.general: The most comfortable weather nationwide is roughly Nov–Feb
seasons.source: Source: general climate of Thailand, Thai Meteorological Department

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Province or place name (Thai or English)
search.nearMeAsk: Allow location access to find nearby places. Your location is not stored.
search.locationDenied: Location permission denied. You can choose a province instead.

chat.title: AI travel assistant
chat.placeholder: Ask about places, food, stays or trip plans…
chat.s2: Plan 3 days in Chiang Mai on a modest budget
chat.s3: Which coast is best for the beach right now?
chat.s4: Which temples and historic sites are worth visiting in Ayutthaya?
chat.notConfigured: No AI provider is configured yet (e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY), so AI answers are unavailable. Below are places from our data that match your question.
chat.noInternal: No places in our data matched your question.
chat.error: Sorry, the AI assistant can't answer right now.
chat.rateLimited: Too many messages. Please wait a moment and try again.
chat.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Check prices and opening hours with the source before travelling.

admin.title: Data admin
admin.forbidden: You don't have access to this page
admin.forbiddenBody: This page is for administrators only. Access is checked on the server.
admin.notConfigured: Supabase must be configured before admin tools can be used.
admin.noLogs: No sync logs in the database yet
admin.syncHowTo: Data sync runs via npm run sync:* scripts (see docs/DATA_SOURCES.md)
admin.missingLicense: Every image has a license and author recorded

footer.about: Yoyo Travel helps you discover places in Thailand using permitted open data. Prices and opening hours can change — please check before travelling.
footer.data: Data: Wikidata (CC0), Wikimedia Commons (per-image licenses), Wikipedia (CC BY-SA), © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), geoBoundaries
